ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area accounting for approximately 85% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for roughly 15% concentrated at the edges and in specific focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form a continuous, irregular band along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; one large, high-contrast white irregular blob is located in the mid-right quadrant; multiple small circular white pixel groups are distributed across the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central axis, measuring approximately 42 degrees, with the vertex partially occluded by high-velocity water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 10 to 30 pixels from the local boundary mean, creating a jagged, saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to sharp, acute distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct high-contrast white circular clusters detected on the right lobe surface and three smaller, unaligned white spots detected on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular white patch on the right lobe indicating significant pigmentation loss or healed scar tissue; jagged trailing edge suggests historical minor tissue erosion.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition between white edge pigmentation and black interior pigmentation is characterized by high-frequency pixel-level mottling rather than a smooth gradient.
